scope_note: Finlight articles found by the existing four-sector English/Chinese searches, published January 1, 2021 through October 14, 2026. Original publisher HTML or provider article responses and extracted full-body text, hashes and retrieval chunks are saved; summaries are never substituted for full bodies. Inaccessible, restricted or truncated articles remain explicit gaps after bounded retries. Completion waits for the existing archive discovery, metadata publication, daily catch-up and committed catalog to catch up, and every indexed article to be processed. This is scoped search coverage, not all worldwide news, certified historical text vintages or verified specialist conclusions.
